pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with sharp edge gradients; patches show a transition from light tan to dark brown with high contrast against the separating corridors. Relative area of patches decreases and becomes more elongated near the dorsal midline.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space pathways. Junction nodes are frequent and form an irregular lattice. Pixel thickness is non-uniform, narrowing significantly as it approaches the upper dorsal region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-to-medium amplitude 1D contour consisting of matted, dark fibers. The frequency is irregular and the silhouette is frequently interrupted by textural anomalies.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Significant structural breaks are visible where the continuous mane line is displaced or obscured by raised nodular growths on the upper neck and shoulder.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Extensive clusters of hyper-pigmented, raised, and rugose textural disruptions are visible along the dorsal ridge and upper right flank, characterized by dark, cauliflower-like pixel clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, dark, nodular masses and crusty skin lesions are prominent on the upper dorsal and right-lateral regions, indicating significant physical trauma or chronic disease manifestation.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe nodular skin texture that alters the typical smooth curvature of the upper torso and dorsal ridge silhouette.
